descriptionEn: Whisky sour topped with a red wine float. The visual alone is worth it.
descriptionZh: 威士忌酸酒上漂浮一层红葡萄酒。光是视觉就值回票价。

details.eyebrowZh: 现代经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约18%
ingrEn: ½ oz (15ml) Full-bodied red wine (Malbec or Shiraz)
ingrZh: 2 oz (60ml) 黑麦或波本威士忌
½ oz (15ml) 浓郁红葡萄酒（马尔贝克或西拉）
stepsEn: Dry shake whiskey, lemon, syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double-strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Float the red wine: pour it slowly over the back of a bar spoon held just above the surface of the drink. It should sit in a distinct layer on top.
Garnish with a lemon wheel. The visual contrast is the whole point.
stepsZh: 将威士忌、柠檬汁、糖浆和蛋白干摇15秒，不加冰。
双重过滤至放有大冰块的岩石杯中。
漂浮红酒：将吧勺背面贴近酒液表面，缓缓将红酒沿勺背倒入，使其形成清晰的分层。
用柠檬片装饰。视觉对比才是这杯酒的灵魂。
details.notesEn: The New York Sour is a Whisky Sour with a red wine float — simple in concept, stunning in execution. Use a full-bodied red with some fruit character (Malbec works beautifully). The float must be poured slowly or it sinks and muddies everything.
details.notesZh: 纽约酸酒是加了红酒漂浮层的威士忌酸酒——概念简单，呈现惊艳。使用浓郁果香的红酒（马尔贝克效果极佳）。漂浮层必须缓慢倒入，否则会沉下去，混浊一片。
